No first purchase

Attention that never turns into revenue

Someone who loves your content and your webinar but isn’t ready for coaching has nothing to say yes to today, so most of that attention earns nothing.

DM bottleneck

Every seat starts with a message

“DM webinar” means each new attendee needs a reply from you or your team before they’re even in. That caps how many people you can bring in each week.

Open calendar

Calls with anyone

An open booking link means time spent on calls with people who were never going to start, and no simple way to spot the serious ones first.

The people who aren’t ready for coaching today leave with nothing to buy, and you can’t tell the ready ones apart until you’ve spent a call on them.

Questions

Before you start

Is this medical advice or therapy?

No. The kit is educational coaching content. It doesn’t diagnose or treat anything and isn’t a replacement for your doctor or therapist.

Do I need a diagnosis?

No. The kit is for anyone who wants routines that are easier to start and keep, whether or not you have a diagnosis.

How long does it take?

About 15 minutes a day for 7 days, and you keep access to come back any time.

Why only $27?

Because the first step should be easy. Start here, and if you want more support, there’s a way to work with Jheri afterwards.
